facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.enable_lie_group_checks: use the enable_checks context manager to temporarily enable Lie group validation checks

facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.disable_checks_for_vmap: disable Lie group checks before running vmap operations to avoid RuntimeError on batched tensors

facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.build_LieGroupFns: build a LieGroupFns namespace wrapping exp, log, compose, inv, transform, and jacobian operators for a Lie group module
facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.create_UnaryOperatorFactory: create a UnaryOperatorFactory that returns op and jop callables for a given module and operator name

facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.create_SE3_identity: create an identity SE3 group tensor with optional batch dimensions and gradient support
facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.compute_SE3_exp_map: compute the exponential map from a 6D tangent vector to an SE3 group element

facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.transform_points_SE3: transform 3D points by an SE3 group element using transform or untransform operations

facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.build_SO3_random_rotations: build a python module to generate random SO3 rotation matrices using rand or randn
facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.create_SO3_exp_map: create a function that computes the exponential map from a tangent vector to an SO3 rotation matrix
facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.create_SO3_log_map: create a function that computes the logarithm map from an SO3 rotation matrix to a tangent vector
facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.test_SO3_quaternion_to_rotation: test the QuaternionToRotation class that converts unit quaternions to 3x3 rotation matrices
facebookresearch_theseus/torchlie/torchl.review_SO3_transform: review the TransformFrom class that applies SO3 rotation matrices to 3D vectors with autograd support
